r_function: eigen(M, symmetric = TRUE) of the fit rows' cov2cor(S) / S; scores = D^-1 (x - centre) %*% v / sqrt(lambda); varimax: stats::varimax(A_k) through rot_canon, scores %*% rotation. Asserted against prcomp predict()/sdev (unweighted and the rep()-expanded frequency fit, sign-aligned), psych::principal(rotate = 'varimax')$scores (unweighted correlation), and unit variance on the fit rows.
note: Fit rows: complete on every member, w > 0, and (fit_on) fit_on.field == fit_on.level. S = the ddof = 1 covariance on w* (wcov). Eigenvectors carry Pulse's sign rule (largest-magnitude component positive). scores is rows x components: every component (rotation none) or the k rotated (varimax, after Pulse's order-and-sign rule); a row null on any member is null in every column (row order = the fixture's).
